item.title: Captures: own smileys page (#601), filtered topic lists (#603)
item.body:
Closes #601
Closes #603
Claim: mac/cap-601-603

**Problem.** The smiley picker and the category filters could not be built without guessing: a member's own smileys and the filtered topic lists were not captured.

**Cause.** Neither state was in the corpus.

**What changed.**
- New anonymized fixtures `R601a`-`d` and `R603a`-`f`, manifest run 14 (runs 12 and 13 are #586's), `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` §6c "Smiley page and filtered lists". Nothing in the engine or the app. 22 requests, 2 logins and 20 GETs, no forum write.
- Two kit changes: a `keyword<N>` control in both verifiers, and `tns3` optional in REST buckets.
- The corpus rows sit before `R335a`, so `corpus.json` does not collide with #586. `MANIFEST.md` and `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` insert at the same place as #586: whoever merges second keeps both blocks, in run order.
- Two issues in one PR, against AGENTS.md §3.6: they were one read-only capture batch. The operator decides whether that stands.

`Closes` holds: every step of #601 and #603 is captured or answered. Left for later: #613 (all 11 smiley slots filled, an `owntopic=1` or `3` list with a sticky row, legacy oracles of `R603a`-`e`) and #278 (paging of filtered lists beyond the one `page=2` measured). Some raw pages are not published, for size or as repeats; the protocol entry labels what rests on them, and `R601d`'s empty body, as run observations.

**Tests.** 319 kit tests pass, 75 script tests pass, `check --corpus` 529 of 529 clean, `check-lot-deps.py` and `markdownlint-cli2` 0 errors, `pre-commit run --all-files` passes. Kit tests of this PR: `test_positions.py`, `SmileyPageTests` (planted names and keywords in slot codes, images and inputs; the keyword control is shown to fail on planted values), `test_rest_buckets.py`, `test_an_author_without_avatar_has_no_tns3`. Independent leak check (own harvest, 17 of 17 planted values found): PASS at fc78741b. Later commits are a merge of `dev-swift`, docs and the order of `corpus.json`: no kit logic, no fixture.

## Adversarial review (Opus 5.5) at b7181b777cc087b6a5bf21c23f61682de165d291

**REQUEST CHANGES.** Read: FIXTURES, LESSONS, AGENTS §3, §5, §8, REVIEW-ROUNDS, the diff, `R601a`-`d`, `R603a`-`f` with metas, `R55-p5`, `R56b`, `R08-2`, `R121e`, and the legacy files at `2440d79`. Run at this head: `check --corpus` 529 of 529 clean, plus mutations on copies. Leak harvesting out of scope. Swift tests not run here: at review time the Linux and macOS HFRKit jobs were still pending.

**Kit: no finding.**
- `keyword<N>`: both verifiers fail on double, single and no quotes, upper case, a line break, `name` after `value`, and a value that only starts with the placeholder. With `>` inside the value the regex layer misses it and the redactor leaves it, but the independent parser still fails it. `keywords<N>` stays out, as the test says.
- Slot codes: a real name fails with and without `:N`, in filled and empty slots, in image path and in `alt`, on `R601a`, `R601b` and `R601c`.
- `tns3` optional is safe: only absence is allowed. `null`, an empty string, a non-alias id and another key name all fail, and absence carries no data. No engine code reads the key.

**Confirmed:** all row, flag and icon counts of `R603a`-`d`, pagers, titles, `R601a`-`c` slot counts, `R603f`, every legacy citation, `uploadsmil` absent from legacy. In the whole corpus, no row has a flag image on a no-news row. `fc78741b..b7181b77` touches neither the kit nor the protocol.

### Findings

1. **High. `MANIFEST.md:382`: CI red.** `Docs consistency` fails at this head: MD056, the unescaped `|` of `owntopic=1|3` in a code span (LESSONS 20). Fix: `1\|3`.

2. **Medium. `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:670`, `MANIFEST.md` row `R601d`: "empty body" is not shown.** `R601d` is meta only, and a meta holds no body or size, so the section's own definition of **verified** is not met. Scenario: a logged-out detection for that page is written against a fact no test can read. Fix: label it a run observation, keep the verified status for 200, no redirect, no cookie.

3. **Medium. `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:16` (R2 row) and `:673`: "a filtered list is one page" is general, the evidence is not.** The markup proves one page 2 of one category, `owntopic=3`. "Same topics" is a run observation, as `:673` says, and other pages and forums are unmeasured; the R2 row states it flatly. #427 and #593 will build paging on this line. Fix: in R2, "seen on cat 13, run observation", and link #278.

4. **Medium. `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:679`: uncaptured states without an issue, and one that contradicts itself.** The pending list names no issue while #601 and #603 close. "A filtered list with a sticky row published (`R08-2` has one…)" names a published fixture as missing one, and `R603e` has a sticky row too. Fix: say what is really missing, and cite or open an issue.

5. **Low. `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:669`: two wrong details.** The first slot's file input is `img_file`, not `img_file0` (`R601c:26`), so `img_file<N>` fails on slot 0. `tr.profil` is 12 rows, the column headers included, so "one per slot" miscounts by one.

6. **Low. `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:675`, MANIFEST `R603e`: a shape left out.** The second of the three category headers holds no topic, only the row "Aucun nouveau message", in the middle of the list. "5 rows" hides it, and a parser that reads this placeholder as "empty page" (`R123g`) would be wrong here.

7. **Low. `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:545` and `:662`: older text not updated.** `:545` still says authors carry `tns3` without the exception. `:662` keeps B6 fully open while `:677` adds a run observation on it: cross-link them.

8. **Low. PR body and MANIFEST.** Two issues in one PR against rule 3.6: fine if the operator accepts it, but say so. "Run 12" collides with #586, and `corpus.json` conflicts on the same line: whoever merges second renumbers. Lot column `composer` in the `R601*` rows is not a lot id.

## Adversarial review round 2 (Opus 5.5) at 1810ae79dea59585f5e0a0a2cad46ce893eeff14

**REQUEST CHANGES.** Every round 1 finding is really fixed, and one fix wording overclaims. It takes one line. Head unmoved. Scope: `b7181b77..1810ae79`, with `docs/FIXTURES.md` read first. Run here: 319 kit tests, `check --corpus` 529 of 529. Swift tests not run here: at review time the Linux and macOS jobs were pending. No forum request.

### Findings

1. **Low. `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:545` and `:678`, `MANIFEST.md:374`: "without avatar" is not what `R603f` shows.** The fixture shows that `tns3` is absent on 3 of the 4 `author` and `last_author` objects, not why: no file says those members have no avatar, and members are aliased. `:678` sits under **verified**, the same class as round 1 finding 2. Scenario: an avatar lot treats absence as "this member has none", while it may mean something else in this bucket. This is the open CodeRabbit thread on `:545`; the wording came from round 1 finding 7, which asked for the exception, not for the cause. Fix: "`tns3` can be absent (`R603f`)", and "why is not captured" if you want it said. `tooling/fixtures/README.md:119` and `test_an_author_without_avatar_has_no_tns3` state the kit rule, which is unaffected; align the words only if you touch them.

2. **Low, tracker only. #278 does not hold what `:16`, `:673`, this PR body and #613 send to it.** #278's scope is logged-in paging of one forum and never names a filtered list, and #613 says it does not repeat that case. Scenario: #278 closes on an unfiltered page and the filtered paging is left with no owner. Fix: one comment on #278 adding the filtered case. No file changes.

### Round 1 findings

| # | Status |
|---|---|
| 1 MD056 | Fixed, `1\|3`; `Docs consistency` is green |
| 2 `R601d` empty body | Fixed: **verified** for 200, no redirect, no cookie; the body is a run observation, in the protocol and in `MANIFEST.md` |
| 3 "One page" general | Fixed: R2 row and the bullet say cat 13, one `page=2` of `owntopic=3`, other pages and forums not measured |
| 4 Pending states | Fixed: #613 exists, the sticky wording no longer contradicts itself. `R603a`-`d` have 0 sticky rows, `R603e` 1, `R08-2` 1, as stated |
| 5 Details | Fixed: `img_file` on slot 0, `img_file<N>` after it, `keyword0`; 12 `tr.profil` in `R601b` and `R601c`, 1 header and 11 slots |
| 6 Shape left out | Fixed: `R603e` has 3 headers, the second holds only `tr.sujet` "Aucun nouveau message", 5 topic rows, 1 sticky, all `flag0.gif` |
| 7 Older text | Fixed for B6 (`:662` links `:677`); `:545` is updated, see finding 1 |
| 8 PR body, MANIFEST | Fixed: Run 14 everywhere, no "run 12" left for this batch, lot column `104` is the smiley picker (LOT-104), rule 3.6 stated |

### Regressions

The commits after `b7181b77` change only `MANIFEST.md`, `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` and the order of `corpus.json`: no kit logic, no fixture. `corpus.json` holds the same entries, moved, and merges with #586 with no conflict. Moving rows changes no alias: `rest_cats` is reset per capture. Merged tree of both heads: 333 kit tests, `check --corpus` 568 of 568; only the expected `MANIFEST.md` run block conflicts.

### Upstream login

`git log -p` of the branch, commit messages and authors included, with my own search (lower-cased, punctuation removed, URL-decoded; also reversed, hex, base64, digit-for-letter): 0 hits; this branch cites no upstream at all. Operator config values: 0 hits on added lines.

### Notes, not blocking

- Two issues in one PR, against rule 3.6: accepted by the operator.

## Adversarial review round 3 (Opus 5.5) at fdb670893159e16d41d8aeebdca2011904257f18

**APPROVE.** Both round 2 findings are fixed and nothing regressed. Head unmoved. Scope: `1810ae79..fdb67089`. Run here: 319 kit tests, `check --corpus` 529 of 529. No forum request.

### Round 2 findings

| # | Status |
|---|---|
| 1 "Without avatar" | Fixed in the three places. `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md:545` "it can be absent (`R603f`)", `:678` "`tns3` can be absent from an author or last author", `MANIFEST.md:374` "`tns3` can be absent". No cause is stated. Measured on `R603f`: 1 of the 4 `author` and `last_author` objects has `tns3`. The phrase is gone from the protocol and the manifest, apart from `:260`, a profile page of an account with no avatar, a different and verified fact |
| 2 #278 | Fixed. The comment on #278 adds the filtered case: cat 13, `page=2` of `owntopic=3`, `R603b` and `R603c`, says other pages, filters and forums are not measured, and asks for one more filter and category. It matches `MANIFEST.md`. #278 is open, and the comment holds no pseudo |

### Regressions

The commit changes only those three lines: no kit logic, no fixture, no `corpus.json`. `git merge-tree` with #586 conflicts only on the expected `MANIFEST.md` run block; none with `dev-swift` at `7880ba5d`.

### Notes, not blocking

- `tooling/fixtures/README.md:119` and `test_an_author_without_avatar_has_no_tns3` keep the older words. They state the kit rule, and round 2 left them to you if you touch them.
- #586 has one finding open at round 3. It does not touch this PR, and only the merge order of the `MANIFEST.md` block links the two.
- Two issues in one PR, against rule 3.6: accepted by the operator.

### State at this head

- **CI:** Linux, fixture tooling, docs, lint, gitleaks, pre-commit and CodeQL are green. Pending: `HFRKit tests (macOS) + iOS 27 build` and `App build + tests` (both queued). This APPROVE does not cover them. Swift tests not run here.
- **CodeRabbit:** 0 open threads of 1, its check on this head is `success`.
